description: This file contains functions and imports related to bug localization, ranking files, processing source code, and evaluating ranking effectiveness, specifically for a project involving bug localization and GUI data analysis.

classes.name: BugLocalization
classes.description: Class responsible for ranking files based on bug localization techniques.

methods.name: reorder_rankings
methods.description: Boosts ground truth files to the top of the ranking while preserving their relative order.

methods.name: localize_buggy_files_with_GUI_data
methods.description: Processes a project with GUI data to localize buggy files using enriched information.

methods.name: localize_buggy_files_without_GUI_data
methods.description: Processes a project without GUI data to localize buggy files using baseline methods.

methods.name: to_corpus_embeddings
methods.description: Converts preprocessed source files into embeddings, optionally filtered by corpus.

methods.name: to_repo_files
methods.description: Reads all source code files from a directory into a list of file content tuples.

methods.name: get_buggy_file_rankings
methods.description: Generates rankings of files based on ground truth bug locations.

methods.name: collect_repos
methods.description: Collects repository paths based on provided criteria.

methods.name: hits_at_k
methods.description: Counts how many rankings are within the top-k positions.

methods.name: calculate_map
methods.description: Calculates Mean Average Precision (MAP) at a cutoff k for ranking results.

methods.name: find_first_rank
methods.description: Finds the best (minimum) rank among buggy files.

methods.name: sum_reciprocal_rank
methods.description: Calculates the reciprocal rank for a set of rankings.

methods.name: calculate_mrr
methods.description: Calculates Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) across multiple projects.

methods.name: calculate_effectiveness
methods.description: Evaluates the minimum, maximum, and average ranks of buggy files.

methods.name: calculate_improvement
methods.description: Computes the relative improvement between GUI-enhanced and baseline rankings.
